notes.title: To The Future
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Landlords, [/h1]

We wanted to stop by and let everyone know about what we are doing with this game and others. 

So in regards to Landlord Simulator we are still working on small little updates to change the rate of things happening, or adding in special event on certain days or months. We are not going to add anything that will require a game restart of source so no need to worry about large updates like that. We might do free DLC later on that might add large things possibly but only if we can do it without requiring a game reset.

Next you can keep up with our new game in the making on our website, its a game that is going to be geared toward the blind & visually disabled. We are also going to cut down on the amount of assets used in all games going forward as well, both PC and mobile as well. It may be too late for Landlord to change but we intend to take this as a learning experience and do thank everyone who gave input throughout the entire process.  As always let us know about bugs on our website the link is included down below. 

[url=https://www.mastercalamitygames.com/]https://www.mastercalamitygames.com/[/url]

notes.title: What is where ?
notes.content:
So we wanted to post something here, We have been seeing in the new reviews and discussions that the game is just riddled with bugs apparently. 
But we have tested the game over and over 50+ hours and have fixed all bugs that we have come across. We take bugs in our game very seriously and if one is found please let us know so it can be corrected.
So we wanted to reach out here as well to see if anyone can tell us of any bugs they might be seeing in their play through of the game.

thank you
MasterCalamity Games

notes.title: The Final update & the future
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Landlords,[/h1]

So today after a year of working night and day on forming this lump of clay into a game we have the [b]final version of Landlord simulator[/b]. To start off we have addressed and added the following:
[list]
 [*]The fps issue outside is now 100% solved and correct
 [*]The fps in steppe is 100% solved and corrected
 [*]A new mini game for fixing had been implemented and tested 
 [*]The AI has been reworked and tested 
 [*]A new pause addition has been added
 [*]The tutorials have changed into an easier to read format 
 [*]The tutorials will now act individually (so no more popping up if you have already closed it)
 [*]The apartments have been Added and Tested 
 [*]The stat screen has been changed 
[*][u][b] You will have to restart Sorry[/b][/u] 
[/list]
So going forward we are not going to be [b]adding any more playable features to the game if anything is added if will be purely cosmetic[/b]. We have worked very hard to ensure we found and fixed any bugs and glitches that were there. But we will still remain vigilant if any more might arise. We will check the discussion here [b]once a week [/b] or so but the best way to let us know of any other problems is through our [url=https://www.mastercalamitygames.com/]website[/url]. 

We want to thank everyone who has helped us get to this point and give us suggestion to what would be nice addition to the game. We implemented those that would not changed it into a different game than what we had imaged all the way in the beginning. We can’t be more thankful to everyone.

As we slowly transition to full release and into the start of a new game we will post any details here just in case you might want to follow it.

notes.title: V3.3.0 part 1 of 6
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Landlords,[/h1]

So today we have the long and delayed update to v3.3.0 and it is going to be a fun one. So to start off as the title states this is [b][u]part one out of six.[/u][/b] We are going to be releasing mini updates throughout the month. At least once a week and one extra somewhere in the mix so lets explain what's going on here. 

This update did cause a lot of problems because when it was getting done it interfered with a lot of the other game mechanics. So we had to break it down piece by piece to get everything working. Then at the same time balancing was a large issue because what fun is a game you can spam a single building for money. So while doing all that we said this town looks a little empty and full of trees. So over the month the [b]mini updates[/b] are going to bring a few different things. 
[list]
[*]More mechanics or flushed out ones anyways
[*]A larger town to explore and enjoy
[*]Buildings that are just for show 
[*]Two to four other businesses to own
[*]Apartments to own and manage 
[*]Little bug fixes
[/list]
[b]So As far as what is in this update please take a look below[/b] 
[list]
[*]Two starter businesses to own
[*]New buildings in the town 
[*]Abandoning home function now fixed  
[*]Balanced gameplay for now
[*]Apartments to own and manage 
[*]Lowered AI count
[*]New tutorials 
[*]Possibly fixed optimization
[/list]
So going forward we are going to barrel through this last month and finally reach that finished fleshed out game. One that is shiny and ready for the leap out of Early access.

notes.title: Great Update News
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Landlords,[/h1]

So Today we are so glad to say that the update is completely finished and in the testing phase now and so far everything works.  As of now we are just making some last minute changes to some wording or the way something looks, but unlike last time it’s actually working. So we won't go into any details right now this was more of a “hey it's testing and everything is looking good.” So in other news we are going to be releasing the update between the 28th and the 30th. This is to give the next update a more fresh time frame seeing how it is the last one. So keep an eye out on the 28th more than anything and continue to have fun until then.

MasterCalamity Games

notes.title: The good, the bad & the ugly
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Landlords,[/h1]

So here we are again, the good news is after the bug testing and reworking this morning we found the problem. But the bad news is it was linked to to several other scripts which means its going to have to be reworked. If we said this update was fun it would be far from the truth but if everything went well in game development where would the challenge be right. So instead of an update then smaller ones we are going to double or nothing.  We are going to instead do one large update that will include the mini games and the business and all the fixes like planned originally a month ago. We are truly sorry for all those who have been waiting for a new update only to met with such news. But now that we know what went wrong we can work on fixing it and getting everything back on track finally. We still aim to have the game finished by the end of october so if there is anything that you would like to see added now is definitely the right time. As always enjoy the current version and keep an eye open for more news or the update itself. 

MasterCalamity Games

notes.title: A new way to v3.0.0
notes.content:
Hello Landlords,

Today we have rather great news …. You have to restart again. Yes we know it horabble but once again we have tried to ensure it won’t happen again hopefully. But in all seriousness this updates brings a slew of new features that have been asked for and other that we added in ahead of schedule. First and foremost you will now be able to choose how much you charge for rent. But you also will have a background moral meter that will start to affect you late in game. We also added an in game tutorial and got rid of the game guide for now. The ui has changed as well and the way the houses themselves work. We have also worked in some new and expected features of owning a home. Below is an overview.
[list]
[*]Changed Ui
[*]Changed home scripting
[*]Added tutorial
[*]Added moral meter
[*]Added ability to increase and decrease rent
[*]Changed fixing mini game
[*]Rebalanced steppe grocery game 
[*]Add new functions to AI
[*]Added home insurance 
[*]Added natural disasters & unnatural disasters 
[*]Added biannual property tax
[*]Added true stats 
[/list]

It seems that there was a major bug that got past our testing squad that affected the saves of the last build and we do apologize for this, but we have released a patch to fix the issue. In other news we have double checked the next few updates and at this time it doesn't seem like the game will need to be restarted again. This of course is subjected to change but there is about a 75% chance that everything will be smooth sailing.

notes.title: Shopping Anyone
notes.content:
Hello landlords,

Another fine update has been added this time adding a new building in the town. If you go to this place you will find that it’s called Steppe Grocery and with it offers the ability to earn extra money. If you go inside you will be tasked to pick items up for tenants and at the end you can get a max of $600 for doing so.  The fixing mechanic has also been changed to something a bit more fun in our option anyway.  Now you will have a green square that must be on top of red triangles to fix the issue with four different “stages” each fast than the last. Below is an overview of everything changed.

- New Fixing mechanic
- Steppe Grocery mini game 
- First person focus added
- New method of holding items
- Controls changed 
- Fixed Issue Count while inside

Next we are going to leave the mini games and insides alone for now and start to work on the people of the town. We are going to be working on AI and other things to start making the town feel like a real town and not being so lifeless. We don’t really have a timeline currently but we are hoping it will be done in just a few weeks due to the fact we previously started already. 

Thank you
MasterCalamity Games

notes.title: Interiors Galore
notes.content:
Hello Landlords,
I would like to say we are now at V2.0.0 and the interiors are finally here, you will have to start a new game but it is worth it. Now as homes are bought, you have the ability to go inside whenever. If there is an issue, you will have to pay to get inside to fix it, but that's just the cost of materials. We have also organized the game guide more to make it easier to follow and added a controls section. But we removed it in the game so you have to read it on the start screen nown. Below is a summary of what happened with this update. 

- Added interiors ( 2 for each home)
- Fix yourself method
- Ability to pick up items 
- Changed game guide
- Fixed price per issue glitch
- New game required 

So next on the agenda is to get some mini games into the pan to make time fly by instead of the slow crawl it is now. We are also going to touch on maps of some kind, to help you find your way around town, while we also have a few different ideas in mind already, some of which are going to be based off the work we have done in this update. Don't forget to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/master_calamity] Twitter[/url] for to the minute news about the current update in progress and other working in the lives of developers.

notes.title: First day Bugs squashed
notes.content:
Hello Landlords,
We know it is only the first day, but we heard about some bugs that needed to be corrected and below is what we have addressed so far.

- Condition meter wasn't advancing up after homes are purchased. 
- Buttons cycles through with the W, A, S, D keys.
- Happiness being able to go negative. 
- Time control resetting when approaching homes. 

So if any more bugs are found please lets us know [url=https://www.mastercalamitygames.com/share-your-ideas] Here	[/url]. 

In other news, we are currently hard at work on the interior of the homes to where you will be able to go inside the homes and fix the issues yourself without having to spend and arm and a leg. We are keeping it simple at first and will only have a few interiors that cycle through and we will add more as time goes on and more work is completed. We want to go ahead and start to add the more to the game in little amounts so the content is there and we can expand as we continue. 



thank you 

MasterCalamity Games
